Wire matched rationale into run-gate guardrail article evaluation for spec, task-impl, and integration phases.

## Acceptance Criteria
- buildGuardrailArticleEvalPrompt accepts options.acknowledgedRationale.
- buildGuardrailPrompt accepts and forwards the same optional options object.
- PromptBuilder can insert the helper-rendered markdown section without duplicate headings.
- checkGuardrail accepts and forwards the optional options object.
- runGateFlow accepts and forwards guardrail prompt options to checkGuardrail.
- executeSpec and executeDiffBasedGate pass parent spec matched rationale to guardrail evaluation, including executeDiffBasedGate's direct checkGuardrail call.

- executeDiffBasedGate preserves Previously Passed Guardrails context when passing acknowledged-rationale options.
- executeDiffBasedGate filters previous-pass IDs to current guardrail article IDs before rendering the previous-pass section.
- Rendered prompt places matched rationale after Guardrail Articles and before Content while preserving previous-pass and diff-scope ordering.

## Implementation Notes
